messages:
kai: proposing a composite consensus rollout for rwd-v7-compact-int4. micro-shadow 20m -> 0.5% -> 4% -> 20%. want to avoid spurious single-metric rollbacks. posting draft gate rules.

sana: +1. idea: require two metric families (quality, hallucination, perf) to trigger auto-rollback at 0.5%. single-family allowed at >=4%. also add min_sample_per_slice=3k and min_total_per_step=2k.

mira: add longform and rerank slices. longform eval_window 40m min_samples 5k. mark slices with <min_samples as "insufficient_data" so they don't count.

kai: console snippet (compact):
```
rollout_id: RL-20260401-07
model: rwd-v7-compact-int4
sequence: [micro_shadow:00:20:00, steps:[{pct:0.5,dur:00:12:00,require_concurrent_families:2},{pct:4,dur:01:00:00},{pct:20,dur:01:20:00}]]
auto_fallback:
  families:
    quality: {metric: MRR, warn_pct:0.6, rollback_pct:1.5}
    hallucination: {metric: HALLUC_PP, warn_pp:0.2, rollback_pp:0.45}
    perf: {metrics:[LAT_P95,TOK_PER_SEC], rollback_ms:40, rollback_pct_tokens:18}
slices:
  - {name: longform, metric: MRR, min_samples:5000, eval_window:40m}
  - {name: rerank, metric: MRR, min_samples:3000, eval_window:15m}
general: {min_samples_per_step:2000, require_concurrent_for_small_steps:true, preflight_smoke:1000}
```

sana: add a soft-warning at MRR_drop 0.5 -> post to #canary-eyeballs; hard rollback only at family concurrence for 0.5 step. also require 10m stability window per step (40m longform).

mira: logging: capture tokenizer/tokenize-delta and insufficient_data counts in payload. if tokenizer_mismatch_count > 30 in step window abort.

gate-bot: RL-20260401-07 drafted (staging). manual start at /console/rollouts/RL-20260401-07.

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch for 3h. will escalate if queue_depth>400 or tokens/sec drop >15% sustained >5m.

kai: next: mira to export slices (ETA 20m), sana wire warning webhook (ETA 15m), kai to run preflight smoke then kick micro-shadow (ETA 45m). will auto-rollback on any hard-fail and file a short blameless postmortem. :shipit:
